name: Node from .nvmrc
description: Makes the Node version your workspace pins in .nvmrc the version every process in the container gets — `bash -c`, `sh -c`, `docker exec`, an agent CLI, a task runner, an editor extension. A create-time hook runs `nvm install` for your .nvmrc and points a symlink at it; this Feature's own containerEnv puts that symlink ahead of everything else on PATH. It installs neither Node nor nvm — pair it with ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node or anything else that provides nvm.

nvmDir.description: Directory holding nvm.sh. The default is where ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node puts it.

projectDir.description: The directory that is the Node project: where .nvmrc is read from and where node_modules is repaired. Workspace-relative; an absolute value is used as-is; empty (the default) is the workspace root. Exactly one .nvmrc is read, once, at create time — this chooses which one, it does not make the version vary by directory.

installOnCreate.description: Run `nvm install` for the project's .nvmrc at create time.

fixNodeModulesOwnership.description: Before installing, chown an existing ./node_modules to the create-time user. Repairs a named volume mounted there, which first mounts root-owned.
